claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect.caster_choice_gate (per-application choice)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's trigger fires per-creature (on enter, on end-turn, on cylinder-move-into) and the caster chooses ONE of two disjoint effects per activation: Healing Light (heal_hp) or Searing Light (save_gate). CastTimeEffectModeChoice picks one mode for the whole spell, not one mode per-creature-per-trigger-firing. OngoingEffect needs a variant that says: when this trigger fires, the caster selects one of N effect bundles to apply to the triggering creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it: Healing Light [...] Searing Light [...] you can bathe it in one of the lights.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_moves
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cylinder can be moved 'when you move on your turn' — this is a free movement-economy cost, not a standard/bonus action spend. on_caster_spends_action requires an explicit action economy cost; movement is a separate resource. The reposition_attachment atom exists but there is no trigger to fire it from caster movement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.usageLimit (per-creature per-turn cap)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell constrains that each creature may be affected by the light choice at most once per turn across all triggers (enter, end-turn, cylinder-moves-into). OngoingOperation has no per-target per-turn throttle field. Without this, a creature that both enters AND ends its turn in the cylinder in the same turn would be bathed twice, contrary to RAW.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.
